utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Can you hear me all right?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, bit tinny, but that might be this headset.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sounds normal to me.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Ah. Just my bargain headset, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, we've got everyone. Marcus, you look like you've only just sat down.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I have. Traffic on the ring road was ridiculous. Spent longer looking at the same van than I did driving.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Coming past the retail park?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah. Absolutely solid, then nothing. No obvious reason for it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Standard Tuesday, that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: At least you had a nice view of a van.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Callum, do you want to start us off?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, the run to Tollgate for the replacement parts for the line one HPU — all done. Picked them up and they're back here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Callum.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And just an observation from nights: noticed the main conveyor was running a bit warm, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Warm towards the start of the shift, you mean?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, earlier on. Nothing sustained. It was back to normal afterwards.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Mm, okay. Nights can feel warm in there even when it's freezing outside.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, understood. Jamie?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Only that we tested the line 1 TCU yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good. Nice to hear 'fine' for a change.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I know. Nearly didn't recognise the word myself.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona, over to you.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: My investigation into the pressure drop on the BFP isn't happening now. The other shift already sorted it, so that's cancelled.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus, where are you with yours?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The purchase order chase — I've had a first look, nothing major so far. Still working through it, though.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, understood.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, Jamie, thought you were coming in with something.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No, just agreeing. Rare, I know.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Marcus asked me to pass on that the contractor booking is moving from him to me. I'll take that on.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Thanks, boss. Appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Jamie agreeing and the boss taking the phone calls. Unusual morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Don't get used to it. Right, two new bits.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll send the shift handover report round by Wednesday. Normal priority on that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay, Sarah, that works.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus, can you sort the training records for the new starters, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the training records for the new starters when I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. No rush on those.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'm still putting faces to names with the new starters.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Helmets on, specs on, everybody looks vaguely like somebody else.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Then you see them in the car park and don't recognise them at all.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I've had people walk straight past me without the hi-vis.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: You sure that's why?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Cheers, Jamie. Very supportive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes personal — anything else new we need in here?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Nothing else from me.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, I'm all right.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Nothing to add here either.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: We're good from planning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, we'll leave it there. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers, all.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: See you in a bit.
